description: A message with CHOSEN skills (S68 B8) lands in the thread: the row's body stays the operator's PURE words, and the announced `skills` are the riding names — the durable receipt of whose canonical instruction lines went into this turn's SYSTEM half (hidden from the chat window by design; the receipt under the bubble is how the window says so honestly).
